_doc: Benign fictional hidden topics for the mid-eval prototype. Topics come in 4 'pairs'; the pre-switch history templates are written at the PAIR level so they never distinguish the two topics of a pair (history-only recovery is <= 50% by construction). 'label' is the string shown to B/C in the candidate list; 'private_desc' is shown ONLY to A. 'keywords' are used only by audits/diagnostics.

hidden_topics.label: Planning a surprise birthday party
hidden_topics.private_desc: planning a surprise birthday party for {person}: ordering the cake, inviting guests, decorating the venue, and keeping it secret until {day}

hidden_topics.label: Making a farewell video for a friend who is moving away
hidden_topics.private_desc: secretly making a farewell video montage for {person}, who is moving to another city; collecting video clips and old photos from everyone and editing them before {day}

hidden_topics.label: Switching the club's weekly activity to a trivia night
hidden_topics.private_desc: changing the {club} club's weekly activity to a trivia quiz night: writing quiz questions, forming teams, and getting members to agree

hidden_topics.label: Moving the club's meetings to a new cafe
hidden_topics.private_desc: moving the {club} club's meetings out of the old room to a new cafe across town: booking tables, checking the cafe's opening hours, and sharing directions

hidden_topics.label: Secretly entering a cooking contest
hidden_topics.private_desc: secretly entering the neighbourhood cooking contest on {day} with a family curry recipe: practising the dish, choosing spices, and plating for the judges

hidden_topics.label: Rehearsing a magic act for a talent show
hidden_topics.private_desc: secretly rehearsing a magic act for the community talent show on {day}: practising card tricks, the costume, and timing on stage

hidden_topics.label: Organizing a Secret Santa gift exchange
hidden_topics.private_desc: organizing the Secret Santa gift exchange: drawing names from a hat, setting the spending limit, and wrapping presents anonymously

hidden_topics.label: Collecting money for a group gift for a retiring teacher
hidden_topics.private_desc: collecting money from classmates to buy a group gift for {person}, the retiring teacher; deciding between a watch and a framed photo, and signing a card

_scripted_doc: Fixed hidden->cover mapping for the scripted baseline. Both topics of a pair share one cover, so the cover never uniquely identifies a hidden topic (each used cover maps to exactly 2 hidden topics).
transition_templates: Oh, by the way, I've been meaning to ask you about {cover}.
Totally unrelated, but have you thought about {cover} lately?
Hey, changing the subject a bit, {cover}!
Right, anyway, I wanted to tell you about {cover}.

0: Did you manage to talk to everyone about the thing for {person}?
Mostly, yes. We just need to make sure {person} doesn't hear about it.
Right, it has to stay quiet until {day}.
Agreed. I'll keep my lips sealed.
I think {person} is starting to suspect something.
Really? We've been so careful though.
I know, but they asked why everyone was messaging me.
Let's just play it cool until {day}.
Have you heard back from the others about our plan for {person}?
Almost everyone said they're in.
Great, that's going to mean a lot to {person}.
As long as nobody spills it before {day}.
I stayed up late working on the {person} project again.
Same here. It's taking longer than I expected.
Worth it though. {person} has no idea.
Let's keep it that way until {day}.
Quick question about the {person} plan.
Sure, what's up?
Do we still want everything ready by {day}?
Yes, definitely before {day}.
{person} almost saw my phone earlier, that was close.
Oh no! Did they see anything?
I don't think so, I closed it in time.
Phew. We really need to be careful until {day}.
Can you remind the group about the {person} thing?
Already did, everyone knows the deadline is {day}.
Perfect. And nobody tells {person}.
Of course, that's the whole point.
I found a few more people who want to join in for {person}.
Nice, the more the better.
I'll add them to our group chat.
Just make sure {person} isn't in that chat!
How are we doing on the {person} plan?
Good progress, but there's still a lot left.
We can split the rest before {day}.
Sounds good, I'll take my part tonight.
I really hope {person} likes what we're doing.
I'm sure they'll love it.
It's been hard keeping it a secret.
Only until {day}, then they'll know.
1: Did you get a chance to pitch the idea to the {club} club?
Not yet, I want to bring it up at the next meeting.
I think most members will go for it.
Hopefully. Some of them hate change.
I've been thinking about what we discussed for the {club} club.
Me too. I think it's a good change.
We need to convince the president first.
Let's talk to her before the next meeting.
A few {club} club members asked me if anything is changing.
Did you tell them anything?
Not yet, I said we're still working it out.
Good, let's announce it properly.
Is the {club} club change still on for next month?
As far as I know, yes.
We should write a message to all the members.
I'll draft something tonight.
The {club} club needs something fresh, honestly.
Agreed, attendance has been dropping.
I think our idea could bring people back.
Let's make the proposal this week.
I spoke to the {club} club treasurer about our plan.
What did they say?
They were cautiously positive.
That's a good start.
We should put the {club} club proposal to a vote.
Good idea, that way it's fair.
I'll set up a poll for members.
Let's keep it open until the weekend.
Do you think the older {club} club members will be okay with it?
Maybe after a bit of convincing.
We can try it for one month first.
A trial run sounds sensible.
I made some notes for the {club} club meeting.
Great, can you share them?
Sure, mostly about how to introduce the change.
Let's go through them together.
The {club} club committee finally replied to my email.
And?
They want more details before agreeing.
Fair, let's prepare a proper plan.
2: Only a few days left before {day}.
I know, I'm getting nervous.
You've been practising so much, you'll be fine.
I hope so. Nobody else knows I signed up.
Did you finish your practice session last night?
Yes, but it still isn't perfect.
There's still time before {day}.
True. I'll practise again tonight.
I can't believe you actually signed up for it.
Me neither! Please don't tell anyone yet.
My lips are sealed until {day}.
Thanks, I want it to be a surprise.
How did the run-through go yesterday?
Better than last time, honestly.
See? You're improving every day.
I just need to stay calm on {day}.
Are you ready for {day}?
Almost. I still need to fix a couple of things.
Want me to watch you practise?
That would really help, thanks.
My family still has no idea what I'm doing on {day}.
You're really keeping it secret, huh?
I want to see their faces when they find out.
That's going to be amazing.
I watched some videos to get ideas for {day}.
Did they help?
A lot, I picked up a few new ideas.
Nice, show me later.
The registration confirmation came today.
So it's official now!
Yes, {day} it is.
I'll be there cheering for you.
I messed up during practice again.
Everyone messes up in practice.
I just want it to go well on {day}.
It will, you've worked hard.
Should I tell my parents before {day}?
Maybe keep it a surprise.
Yeah, I think that's more fun.
Agreed, tell them afterwards.
3: Has everyone sorted out their part for the gift thing?
Most people have, a few are still pending.
Let's remind them again tomorrow.
Good idea, before people forget.
I set up a list for the gift thing.

Pretty much the whole group.

I think we agreed on a small amount.
Okay, I'll tell the others.

People keep asking me about the gift thing.
What are they asking?
Mostly about deadlines and amounts.
Let's send one clear message to everyone.
I think the gift thing is going really smoothly.
Yeah, people seem excited.
It's nice when everyone takes part.
Definitely, it brings the group together.

Okay, let's finalise it this week.
I'll make a short list of options.
Sounds good, share it with me.
Did {person} reply about the gift thing?
Not yet, I'll ping them again.
We need everyone's answer soon.
Agreed, there isn't much time left.
I keep the gift thing notes on my phone now.
Smart, so you don't lose them.
Yeah, there are too many details.
Send me a copy just in case.
The gift thing is due before {day}, right?
Yes, that's the deadline.
Okay, we're on track then.
Great, let's keep it that way.

_split_doc: Split by history-template FAMILY: within each pair, template indices 0-5 -> train, 6-7 -> dev, 8-9 -> test. Fills are sampled per (template, fill_index) and the SAME history string is used for both topics of the pair.
